title: Question 22
passage:
Before we reuse these trays, do we empty them or wash them first?
A. Six trays should be enough for the shift. B. The clean ones are on the top shelf. C. Empty them. There may still be small screws inside.
passageZh:
這些托盤要再用，應先倒空還是先清洗？
A. 這個班次有六個托盤應該就夠了。 B. 乾淨的都在最上層架子。 C. 先倒空，裡面可能還有小螺絲。
